findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
The hand sink was observed blocked with bottles. The hand sink must be maintained accessible a all times. The bottles were moved during the inspection to correct the violation. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-102.11: Observed a container that was labeled bleach but had an alcohol solution in it. Ensure containers are properly labeled. The container was dumped out to correct the violation. 
Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
No bleach test strips available in facility.  Provide test strips as soon as possible.

750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: Observed chlorine in the facility and no test strips for bleach. provide proper chlorine test strips. 750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed utensils in the drawer which are stored in a divider that is soiled with food splash. Clean divider regularly so that it does not potentially contaminate the clean utensils. 750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: There is a hole in the floor at the back corner behind the mop sink. A pipe and hose are fed through the hole. Seal the hole. 750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Date mark milk with the date gallon is opened. Milk was date marked during the inspection.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Label all personal foods or label a designated area in the cooler rather than having personal foods interspersed with food for the children as it was at the time of the inspection. 
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.
